reviews.text: Loved it. Definitely will order a bigger version of this cleansing oil, just right for oily sensitive skin. Thanks for the gifts, haven’t used these products so it’s a great opportunity to try new products in mini versions. I might like them and order bigger versions.
reviews.zh: 好鍾意！我一定會訂大支裝嘅呢款卸妝油，啱晒油性敏感皮膚。多謝送嘅禮物，我未用過呢啲產品，所以用細裝試新產品係好好嘅機會。我可能會鍾意，然後訂大支裝。

reviews.text: Me gustó bastante, tengo la piel sensible y no me ha generado ninguna reacción. Tiene un ligero olor como a mentol una vez emulsionado, pero no es un olor molesto. Además limpia bastante bien, apenas tiene unos días que lo uso y ya he notado menos residuos en mi rostro.
reviews.zh: 我好鍾意，我嘅皮膚敏感，但冇出現任何反應。乳化之後有少少似薄荷嘅氣味，但唔會令人反感。而且清潔效果都幾好，我只係用咗幾日，就已經覺得面上殘留物少咗。

reviews.text: 数回しか使ってませんが、同じ会社のピュアクレンジングオイルの方が効果を感じました。
reviews.zh: 我只用咗幾次，但係同一間公司嘅ピュアクレンジングオイル反而更加感受到效果。

reviews.text:
On a daily basis I use cleansing oil from Skin 1004, but this one I bought as a part of my travel kit. It''s small and easy to pack. 
This oil has a fairy strong herbal smell, so mind that if you're sensitive to smell. After 3-4 usages I get used to it.
reviews.zh:
我日常用 Skin 1004 嘅卸妝油，但係呢支係我買嚟旅行套裝嘅一部分。佢細細支，好易放入行李。
呢款油有幾濃嘅草本味，所以如果你對氣味敏感要留意吓。用咗3至4次之後我就習慣咗。

reviews.text: I've used it for a few days now on my sensitive, combination skin. First thing I noticed is the quite strong herby scent, which I personally like, as I find it refreshibg. The oil itself has a good consistency that is not too runny nor too thick and removes effortlessly with water.
reviews.zh: 我用咗幾日，我嘅皮膚屬於敏感混合皮。最先注意到嘅係頗為濃烈嘅草本香味，我個人幾鍾意，覺得佢好清新。卸妝油本身質地好好，唔會太稀，亦唔會太稠，用水沖走時好輕鬆。

reviews.text:
The oil is thick, but if you use a small quantity (just enough to cleanse the face), then it doesn’t feel too oily. It cleanses my blackheads well. It has a nice nature smell - trees, pine, grass…
I have used it for two weeks and my face feels fresh and clean.
reviews.zh:
呢款卸妝油質地比較稠，但如果用少量（夠用嚟潔面就得），就唔會覺得太油。佢都好能夠清走我嘅黑頭。有好好聞嘅大自然香味——樹木、松樹、青草……
我用咗兩個禮拜，面部感覺清新乾淨。

reviews.text:
Skin type: acne prone, sensitive skin
This is the first cleansing oil I used (I prefer water based products, as my skin is super sensitive). I am very pleased with the effect! ma:nyo Herbgreen Cleansing Oil gently cleans skin, does not cause any irritation. Will be buying a larger quantity bottle next time
reviews.zh:
膚質：易生暗瘡、敏感肌
呢個係我第一次用卸妝油（我比較鍾意水性產品，因為我皮膚好敏感）。我對效果非常滿意！ma:nyo Herbgreen Cleansing Oil 溫和清潔皮膚，冇引起任何刺激。下次會買大支裝。

reviews.text: This cleansing oil is very good. I used it by rubbing the oil on my dry face for 1 minute and then emulsifying it with water and rubbing that in for 2 minutes, then washing it all off. When I was cleansing, I could literally feel the comedones coming out of my face. When I was done cleansing, many comedones had been removed, like many carrots that had been uprooted from the soil. I chose this cleansing oil because I have nut allergies, and the other version has argan oil i believe. This has a light smell of tea tree oil and sage, but the tea tree oil is very subtle compared to the sage smell. It also didn’t strip my skin which is a good sign that a cleanser is working properly.
reviews.zh: 呢款卸妝油好好。我嘅用法係喺乾燥嘅面上搓揉一分鐘，然後加水乳化，再搓揉兩分鐘，然後全部沖走。潔面嗰陣，我真係感覺到粉刺由面上被推出嚟。潔完之後，好多粉刺都被清走咗，好似好多蘿蔔被拔出泥土咁。我揀呢款卸妝油，係因為我對果仁過敏，而我記得另一個版本有摩洛哥堅果油。呢款有少少茶樹同鼠尾草嘅味道，但係茶樹味比鼠尾草味淡好多。佢亦冇令皮膚失去油分，呢個係潔面產品運作正常嘅好跡象。

note: 以下評價由 Olive Young 顧客撰寫，OUJI 原文引用、只加中文翻譯，冇改動內容，亦冇刪走負評。只顯示我哋有貨嘅色號，同價錢有關嘅評價唔會收錄（兩邊售價唔同）。
